refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.orderHint: Refund all or part of the top-up: the amount goes back to the customer and leaves their wallet.
refunds.sessionHint: Refund all or part of the session: the amount is credited to the customer's wallet.
refunds.irreversible: A credit note will be issued and the customer notified. This cannot be undone.
refunds.amountRange: The amount must be between 0.01 and {{max}}.
refunds.amountCents: The amount is in dirhams and cents.
refunds.reasonRequired: Give the reason for the refund (at least 3 characters).

notes.manual: Manual top-up: refund the customer outside the platform (cash, transfer), then record it here.
notes.provider: {{provider}} cannot refund automatically: refund in its back office, then record it here as refunded outside the platform.

errors.exceeds_paid: This amount is more than what is left to refund.
errors.insufficient_balance: The wallet no longer holds this amount: the customer already spent part of it.
errors.refund_not_supported: This payment cannot be refunded through the provider: choose refunded outside the platform.
errors.key_reused: This refund was already recorded with other values. Open the form again.
errors.in_progress: This refund is already in progress.
errors.not_paid: Only a paid top-up can be refunded.
errors.not_billed: Only an ended, billed session can be refunded.
errors.invalid_reason: Give the reason for the refund.
errors.invalid_method: This refund method is not possible here.
errors.no_card: The charging card of this payment no longer exists.
errors.provider_failed: The payment provider refused the refund: the amount was given back to the wallet.

statements.title: Monthly statements
statements.subtitle: What EVEON collected on your stations each month, its commission and the amount paid out to you.
statements.empty: No statement yet. A month's statement is made at the beginning of the next month.
statements.howItWorks: Every session ended on your stations is in exactly one statement. A session a charger reports late appears in the next statement; a refund granted to a driver is deducted from the statement of the month it was made.
statements.terms: Commission: {{percent}}% of revenue excl. VAT + {{perKwh}} excl. VAT per kWh
statements.vatNote: Amounts in dirhams, VAT included. The VAT on your sales is yours; EVEON's commission is invoiced with VAT.

settlements.title: Partner payouts
settlements.subtitle: Each partner's monthly statements: collections, EVEON commission, VAT and net payout.
settlements.generateHint: A statement to pay is recomputed (new sessions, current terms); a paid statement never changes. Last month is made automatically at the beginning of each month.
settlements.paidSaved: Payout recorded: the statement is frozen.
settlements.termsHint: Share of the revenue excl. VAT EVEON keeps and fixed amount excl. VAT per kWh. Applies to statements made afterwards.
settlements.termsRange: The commission must be between 0 and 100% and the amount per kWh between 0 and 100 MAD.
